verdict.rationale: Shopify documents official libraries for app building, and Shopify CLI scaffolds new apps, themes, and storefronts. Apps integrate into the admin, checkout, and more, extensions can be validated against Shopify schemas, and dev stores provide a test environment. However, the pack has no first-party documentation of an app review, submission, or App Store distribution path, which is a required part of the story. Missing for 10: documented app review/submission process, documented distribution path (App Store listing or custom-app distribution), independent hands-on corroboration of the SDK/CLI developer experience.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build custom apps and extensions with official SDKs, scaffolding tooling, and a documented review/distribution path

citations.quote: Use Shopify's officially supported libraries to build fast, reliable apps with the programming languages and frameworks you already know.
Shopify CLI is a command-line interface tool that helps you generate and work with Shopify apps, themes and custom storefronts.
Initialize new apps, themes, and headless storefronts in an instant with the latest Shopify CLI.
Run the second command to create a new app. Your app will be added as a new subdirectory.
Extend Shopify's core functionality with apps that integrate into Shopify's admin, online store, checkout and more.
validate GraphQL queries, Liquid templates, and Shopify Extensions against Shopify schemas to catch issues earlier
You can connect directly to a dev store from Shopify CLI using the `shopify app dev` command.
